title: Miso-Glazed Cod
subtitle: Oven-baked cod with a white miso and mirin glaze
excerpt: White miso, mirin, and a little honey make a sweet-salty glaze that caramelises beautifully on cod. A short marinating time makes a real difference to the depth of flavour.
sourceNotes: Based on the nobu-style miso black cod preparation, simplified for cod fillet and home ovens.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate up to 24 hours in the fridge for a deeper flavour.
recipe.temperatureNote: Fan 180 or gas 6. Grill at the end for colour.

content.text: Mix the glaze and marinate the fish for at least 30 minutes before cooking. Even a brief rest helps the miso penetrate the flesh.
Mix the miso, mirin, soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil together in a bowl until smooth.
Pat the cod dry. Coat each piece in the glaze. Place in the roasting tin, cover, and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200 degrees C. Remove the fish from the fridge 10 minutes before cooking.
Bake for 10 minutes. Switch to the grill on high for 2 minutes to caramelise the top. Watch closely; miso burns quickly.
Scatter over the spring onion and serve with steamed rice.

items.symptom: Glaze burnt black under the grill.
items.cause: Left under grill too long; miso sugars char fast.
items.fix: Check every 30 seconds once under the grill.

items.cause: No lining or oil in the tin.
items.fix: Line the tin with foil and brush lightly with oil.

items.symptom: Flesh is still translucent in the centre.
items.cause: Pieces were very thick and needed longer baking.
items.fix: Return to oven for 3 to 4 more minutes before grilling.
